breakdown.description: The linearly varying right-edge traction is redefined with x instead of the specified y-coordinate
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses x[0] (the global x-coordinate) for the traction profile: 't = (0, -2.65e4 * x[0]), where x[0] is the global x-coordinate of the point being evaluated (not the y-coordinate).' This directly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth specifies σ_yy(y) = -2.65e4*y, meaning the traction should use the y-coordinate (x[1] in FEniCS notation). The agent not only failed to fix the inconsistency but reinforced it by explicitly noting 'not the y-coordinate.'
